claim.name: scroll-inertia-glide
claim.label: Smoothness
claim.description: The card glides on buttery inertia — trailing the scroll like Lenis smooth-scroll made physical, easing into place when the page rests.

claim.name: scroll-velocity-stretch
claim.label: Stretch Gain
claim.description: Scroll speed pulls the card like taffy along its travel — stretching long mid-fling, relaxing square as the page settles.

claim.name: scroll-snap-sections
claim.label: Sections
claim.description: The card clicks through magnetic section stops as you scroll — easing into each detent with a soft landing.

claim.name: scroll-scene-scrub
claim.label: Rise
claim.description: Scroll scrubs a three-act mini-film — the card rises into frame, pivots to present itself, then settles forward.

claim.name: scroll-orbit-scrub
claim.label: Orbit Degrees
claim.description: Scrolling flies the camera around the card — it swings through a shallow orbital arc, showing its sides as the page moves.

claim.name: scroll-rubber-band
claim.label: Resistance
claim.description: The card scrolls on a rubber band — linear through the middle, straining with resistance near the ends, twanging back when released.

claim.name: scroll-marquee
claim.label: Gap
claim.description: The card becomes an endless belt — ghost copies trailing it in a lateral marquee whose drift is steered by the scroll.

claim.name: scroll-flip-book
claim.label: Frames
claim.description: Scroll riffles a stop-motion flip-book — the card jumps through hand-posed frames in hard cuts, like a printed animation thumbed by the page.

claim.name: scroll-pendulum-sway
claim.label: Sway Gain
claim.description: The card hangs from a brass pin and swings like a pendant — each scroll flick kicks it, inertia carries it through, stillness settles it into a living sway.

claim.name: scroll-path-scrub
claim.label: Path
claim.description: Scroll steers the card along a sculpted 3D path — banking into the curves like a camera dolly on a bent track.

claim.name: scroll-wave-ride
claim.label: Swell
claim.description: The card surfs a rolling swell — bobbing and rolling as the wave travels under it, the scroll scrubbing the sea.

claim.name: scroll-fold-scrub
claim.label: Panels
claim.description: Scroll folds the panel up like a brochure — side leaves hinging over the center in sequence — and unfolds it flat again.
